MERACH W50 vs W60 Walking Pad Review 2026: Which Incline Walking Pad Should You Buy?

TL;DR — The 30-second verdict

  • MERACH W50 (NovaWalk W50 TrekPad) is the heavy-duty value pick: a 400 lb capacity, 3.5 HP peak brushless motor, 10-hour continuous runtime, and whisper-quiet operation (<25 dB) — ideal for heavier users, families, and long work-from-home sessions.

  • MERACH W60 (UltraWalk W60 Plus) is the premium “built-to-last” pick: a 15,000-hour rated motor, SGS-verified 330 lb sustained capacity, 33% wider deck, 5W Bluetooth speaker with RGB lighting, and child-lock — the most feature-complete walking pad under $500.

  • Both share the same 12-level auto incline (up to 12%), the same 16.5” × 41.3” belt size, and the same 0.6–4.0 mph speed range.

  • Buy the W50 if you want maximum weight capacity and all-day endurance at a lower price. Buy the W60 if you want smarter entertainment features and longer motor life.

01 Meet the Contenders

MERACH has become one of the best-selling walking pad brands on Amazon, and the W50 and W60 are its two most popular incline models.

MERACH W50 (NovaWalk W50 TrekPad)

  • Price: From $359.98 ($449.98)
  • Motor: 3.5 HP peak / 1.25 HP continuous brushless motor
  • Weight Capacity: 400 lb (181 kg)
  • Incline: 12-level auto incline (up to 12%)
  • Runtime: 10-hour continuous use
  • Noise Level: <25 dB (ultra-quiet)
  • Warranty: 2-year warranty

MERACH W60 (UltraWalk W60 Plus)

  • Price: From $329.99 ($499.99) + 1-year motor care
  • Motor: 3.5 HP peak / 1.25 CHP continuous brushless motor
  • Weight Capacity: 330 lb sustained (SGS-verified) / 400 lb peak
  • Incline: 12-level auto incline (up to 12%)
  • Features: 5W Bluetooth speaker, RGB lighting, child lock
  • Warranty: Warranty + free 1-year motor care

04 Deep Dive: What Each Model Does Best

MERACH W50 — The Heavy-Duty All-Day Workhorse

400 lb capacity — among the highest in the walking pad category, with a reinforced 15.3 mm deck for a steady, full-treadmill feel.

10-hour continuous runtime — most walking pads shut down after 1.5 hours; the W50 is engineered for all-day desk walking without overheating.

Whisper-quiet brushless motor — measured under 25 dB, quiet enough for calls, TV, or shared apartments.

12-level auto incline — a rare feature at this price; most pads under $400 have no incline at all.

App + third-party support — works with the free Merach App, plus Kinomap, Zwift, Apple Health, and Google Fit.

“The W50 is super sturdy and quiet.” — Jake, verified purchaser

“A healthy habit for remote workers… the non-slip surface feels grippy and stable underfoot.” — Lilian, verified purchaser

“This is the best treadmill for small apartment living. It’s silent and fits right under my desk.” — US customer review

MERACH W60 — The Premium “Built to Last” Upgrade

15,000-hour rated brushless motor — a 105 mm motor with Hall-sensor control and dual-vent convection cooling, built to outlast typical walking pads (~10 years of use).

SGS-verified sustained capacity — 330 lb certified for continuous use (400 lb peak), on a 70 lb all-steel frame with thickened steel.

33% wider deck — the same 16.5” × 41.3” footprint tuned for a freer stride, plus an 8.2 ft power cord so you can place it anywhere.

Entertainment built in — 5W Bluetooth speaker + rhythmic RGB lighting turn walking into an experience, with a child lock for safety.

Smartest control in its class — magnetic remote, Merach App, Apple Health & Google Fit sync, Apple Watch heart-rate display, and pause-memory.

“This is simply the best walking pad I’ve tried. It was so smooth the entire time.” — Certified personal trainer, Garage Gym Reviews testing team

“Sturdy build. It handled my full workload without flexing. Surprisingly quiet — footfalls make more noise than the motor. The app is a real bonus.” — Isaac, SmartHomeExplained.com

06 Pros & Cons

✅ MERACH W50 Pros

  • 400 lb max capacity — best-in-class for heavier users
  • Up to 10 hours continuous use, no forced shutdown
  • Under 25 dB — genuinely quiet for calls and shared spaces
  • 12% auto incline at a budget-friendly price
  • Works with Kinomap, Zwift, Apple Health, Google Fit
  • 2-year warranty included

⚠️ MERACH W50 Cons

  • Basic LED display (metrics cycle every 5s)
  • All controls depend on the magnetic remote
  • 4 mph top speed — walking / light jogging only
  • Incline adjusted manually via remote

✅ MERACH W60 Pros

  • Motor rated for up to 15,000 hours — outlasts typical pads
  • SGS-verified 330 lb sustained capacity on a 70 lb steel frame
  • 5W Bluetooth speaker + RGB lighting for motivation
  • Apple Watch heart-rate display + app pause-memory
  • Child lock — safer for families
  • 50 mm easy-roll wheels, magnetic remote dock, 8.2 ft cord

⚠️ MERACH W60 Cons

  • Heavier box to move (about 67.7 lb unit)
  • 4 mph top speed — not for serious running
  • Premium price unless caught on sale

07 Which One Should You Buy?

Choose the MERACH W50 if…

You’re a heavier user (up to 400 lb), you share the pad with family members of different sizes, or you want all-day desk walking with the quietest possible motor at a lower price. It’s the best value under $400 with a real 12% incline.

Choose the MERACH W60 if…

You want the walking pad to last for years, you love entertainment features (music, RGB light, Apple Watch sync), or you want SGS-verified sustained capacity and a child lock for family safety. It’s the most complete under-desk walking pad you can buy.

Choose either one if…

You need a compact, under-desk, 12-level incline walking pad with a treadmill-grade brushless motor. Both are top sellers for a reason.
